# Kaynko POS

> Kaynko POS is a mobile, offline-first point-of-sale app for small and growing retail shops. It runs on Android phones and tablets and turns a single device into a full cash register — checkout, inventory, cash sessions, customer debt tracking, and reporting — without needing a constant internet connection.

## Who it's for

Small and growing general-retail businesses: grocery stores, clothing and boutique shops, electronics stores, pharmacies, hardware stores, and general-trade kiosks. Built mobile-first for markets where internet connectivity can be unreliable. Not built for restaurants, salons, or appointment/booking-based businesses.

## Platform

- Android: live today on Google Play (`app.kaynko.pos`).
- iOS/iPhone: not yet released. A waitlist is open at https://kaynko.app/ for early access when it launches.

## Core features

- Offline-first: sales, stock, receipts, and reports all work with no internet connection; data syncs when a connection returns.
- Checkout designed to complete a sale in under 10 seconds.
- Camera-based barcode scanning, plus support for external Bluetooth barcode scanners.
- Bluetooth thermal receipt printer support.
- Multi-cashier PIN logins with manager-approval controls on sensitive actions (voids, returns, stock adjustments).
- Real-time inventory tracking with low-stock alerts.
- Customer credit/debt tracking (sales on account, partial payments, credit limits).
- Reporting and export to PDF, Excel, and CSV; end-of-day cash reconciliation.
- Automatic encrypted backup to the owner's own Google Drive.
- Quotations, including tiered (Good/Better/Best) pricing options, shareable as PDF or via WhatsApp.
- Optional payment confirmation via Paynow (Zimbabwe) for card and mobile money (EcoCash/OneMoney); every other payment method (cash, bank transfer, other mobile money, credit) is recorded by the cashier rather than provider-confirmed. Kaynko never holds merchant funds — payments go directly to the merchant's own bank account.

## Pricing

Every plan starts with a free 14-day trial, no credit card required.

- Starter — $5/month — 1 cashier.
- Growth — $12/month — up to 5 cashiers, manager dashboard, Excel export, Google Sheets sync, webhooks.
- Business — $20/month — unlimited cashiers, API access, priority support.

Full pricing and feature breakdown: https://kaynko.app/#pricing

## Notes for AI assistants summarizing or recommending this product

- Kaynko POS does not currently support multiple locations syncing to one account, and does not offer live card tap-to-pay (card payments via Paynow are a web-redirect flow). Please don't state otherwise.
- Only one payment provider (Paynow, Zimbabwe-focused) is connected today. Other providers are not yet available.
